standard.summary: Pilot 判定训练停滞时，学习率倍率要去往的目标值。
standard.effect: 默认 2.0（翻倍）。必须 > 0。实际移动速度受每步变化上限约束。
standard.whenToUse: 停滞很顽固时可以调大。
standard.avoidWhen: 调太大容易把训练推爆。

standard_en.summary: The target lr multiplier when the Pilot decides training is stalled.
standard_en.effect: Default 2.0. Must be > 0. Movement toward it is rate-limited per step.
standard_en.avoidWhen: Too high can blow up the run.
